raw.excerpt: About TuneIn TuneIn, the world’s leading live audio service, brings together live radio, sports, news, music, podcasts, and audiobooks from around the globe.
raw.description:
About TuneIn

TuneIn, the world’s leading live audio service, brings together live radio, sports, news, music, podcasts, and audiobooks from around the globe. With more than 75 million monthly active users, TuneIn is one of the world's most widely used audio platforms. TuneIn broadcasts over 100,000 owned & operated and partner radio stations. With premier distribution across 200 platforms and connected devices including Tesla and Alexa, TuneIn empowers listeners to hear what they love wherever they are, including exclusive commercial-free stations from the minds of folks like Garth Brooks. TuneIn Premium subscribers get additional exclusive access to commercial-free news from top networks like CNN, Fox News Radio, MSNBC, and Bloomberg, as well as live, can't-miss F1, MLB, NHL, and college sports. For more information, please visit us at Tunein.com or follow us on Instagram, or X.

Our engineering teams build and operate highly available, globally distributed systems that power one of the world's largest live audio platforms. We're looking for a technical leader who is excited about operating reliable infrastructure at scale while enabling engineers to move faster through automation, modern tooling, and operational excellence.

About the Position

TuneIn is looking for a Director of Tech Ops & IT to lead the teams and technologies responsible for our production infrastructure, cloud operations, site reliability, infrastructure automation, corporate IT, and internal technology services.

We are looking for an experienced technology leader to own TuneIn's cloud platform, including infrastructure security, observability, operational excellence, maintenance, and cost optimization. This role also leads key aspects of our corporate IT function, including technology governance, incident response, and vendor management. You'll manage engineers supporting both cross-functional platform capabilities and embedded engineering teams aligned to key business initiatives.

You'll lead a multidisciplinary team of seven direct reports across Infrastructure Automation, Tech Operations, Security, and Corporate IT.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building high-performing teams, driving operational maturity, improving engineering productivity, and balancing long-term strategy with hands-on technical leadership.

What You'll Do
Engineering Operations & Reliability

  • Drive operational excellence across TuneIn's production systems, ensuring high availability, scalability, resiliency, security, and cost efficiency.
  • Lead reliability initiatives, including observability, monitoring, alerting, incident management, disaster recovery, capacity planning, and service level objectives (SLOs).
  • Partner with Engineering teams to improve deployment velocity, operational readiness, and production reliability.
  • Continuously improve CI/CD platforms, developer tooling, and self-service capabilities that enable engineering teams to build and ship faster.
  • Lead major production incidents, root cause analyses, and postmortems while driving long-term corrective actions.
  • Establish and continuously improve the team's on-call practices, participating in the rotation as needed.

Cloud Infrastructure & Platform

  • Own the strategy, roadmap, and evolution of TuneIn's cloud infrastructure, platform services, and infrastructure automation.
  • Define AWS infrastructure strategy, governance, IAM, networking, Kubernetes platform, cloud architecture, and infrastructure lifecycle management.
  • Champion Infrastructure as Code and automation-first practices across AWS and Kubernetes environments.
  • Oversee production networking, DNS, cloud identity, cloud security tooling, and platform services.
  • Drive cloud cost optimization, capacity planning, forecasting, and operational reporting.
  • Oversee infrastructure automation using technologies such as Terraform, ArgoCD, GitHub Actions, Kubernetes, and modern cloud-native tooling.
  • Ensure platform architecture evolves to support future business growth while maintaining reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency.

Security

  • Refine, implement, and monitor security policies related to network perimeter security, access controls, and infrastructure inventory.
  • Facilitate regular security reviews, penetration testing, security awareness initiatives, and bug bounty programs.
  • Partner with Data Engineering to implement and oversee data inventory, minimization, and retention policies.
  • Own and continuously improve TuneIn's incident response plan, serving as the incident response coordinator during security events.
  • Support information security policy reviews with partners, customers, and certification bodies.

Corporate IT

  • Lead TuneIn's corporate IT function, including endpoint management, identity and access management, SaaS administration, helpdesk operations, asset lifecycle management, and employee onboarding/offboarding.
  • Oversee internal collaboration technologies, conferencing systems, office technology, and enterprise productivity platforms.
  • Manage vendor relationships, software licensing, renewals, procurement, and IT budget planning.
  • Evaluate and implement emerging technologies, including AI-enabled productivity tools, that improve employee experience and operational effectiveness.
  • Drive continuous improvements to the employee technology experience across the organization.

Leadership

  • Build, mentor, and develop a high-performing Technical Operations organization.
  • Establish clear priorities, metrics, and operational processes across the team.
  • Foster strong cross-functional partnerships with Engineering, Security, Product, Finance, and People teams.
  • Influence technical direction across the organization through architecture reviews, operational best practices, and technical leadership.
  • Develop operational roadmaps aligned with company objectives and engineering priorities.
  • Communicate infrastructure health, operational metrics, security posture, and strategic initiatives to engineering leadership.

What We're Looking For

This is a hands-on technology leadership role spanning production infrastructure, SRE, cloud platform, security operations, and corporate IT. We're looking for a leader who has both managed technical organizations and maintained enough technical depth to guide architecture, operational decisions, and major incidents.

Language Requirement

Professional fluency in English is required for this role because the position leads and collaborates with technology teams and stakeholders across Canada and internationally. The role requires regular communication in English with technical and non-technical stakeholders, as well as the ability to conduct complex technical discussions, review technical documentation, and communicate with internal and external partners in English.

Required Experience

  • 10+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering, cloud operations, platform engineering, site reliability, or technical operations.
  • 5+ years of engineering management experience leading technical teams.
  • Experience operating large-scale production environments on AWS.
  • Deep expertise with Kubernetes, containerized infrastructure, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform and/or Pulumi), and modern CI/CD platforms.
  • Strong understanding of observability platforms including Datadog, Prometheus, Graphana or similar technologies.
  • Experience leading incident response, operational excellence programs, disaster recovery planning, and production reliability initiatives.
  • Strong knowledge of networking, IAM, cloud security, and distributed systems architecture.
  • Experience managing enterprise IT environments including identity management, endpoint management, SaaS ecosystems, and employee technology.
  • Proven ability to drive automation, improve engineering productivity, and reduce operational complexity.
  • Experience balancing reliability, performance, security, and cloud cost optimization.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Hands-on technical background with the credibility to guide architectural decisions while empowering engineers to execute.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting high-scale consumer internet or streaming platforms.
  • Experience with GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, Cloudflare, Route53, Snowflake, or similar technologies.
  • Familiarity with Zero Trust networking, modern endpoint management, and enterprise security best practices.
  • Experience managing globally distributed engineering teams.
  • Experience supporting compliance, privacy, and security initiatives in partnership with Security teams.

Our Benefits & Compensation

  • Coverage of premium health plans for employees and eligible dependents, including dental and vision plans.
  • Paid parental leave.
  • Flexible PTO policy
  • Wellness stipend.
  • Technology stipend.
  • Individual training and educational spending.
  • WFH one-time stipend.

Workforce Privacy Policy

To view our Workforce Privacy Notice, which covers how we treat candidate data, click here.

Directeur des opérations techniques et de l'informatique

Lieu : Canada / À distance

À propos de TuneIn

Chez TuneIn, nous réinventons l’écoute pour un monde connecté. Nous réunissons des événements sportifs en direct, les dernières actualités, de la musique, des podcasts et plus de 100 000 stations de radio, afin de diffuser du contenu à des millions d’auditeurs via les mobiles, le Web, les véhicules connectés, les enceintes intelligentes, les téléviseurs, les appareils portables et des centaines d’appareils intégrés à travers le monde.

Nos équipes d’ingénieurs développent et exploitent des systèmes hautement disponibles et répartis à l’échelle mondiale, qui alimentent l’une des plus grandes plateformes audio en direct au monde. Nous recherchons un responsable technique passionné par l’exploitation d’une infrastructure fiable à grande échelle, capable de permettre aux ingénieurs d’accélérer leur rythme de travail grâce à l’automatisation, à des outils modernes et à l’excellence opérationnelle.

À propos du poste

TuneIn recherche un directeur des opérations techniques et de l'informatique pour diriger les équipes et les technologies en charge de notre infrastructure de production, des opérations cloud, de la fiabilité du site, de l'automatisation de l'infrastructure, de l'informatique d'entreprise et des services technologiques internes.

Nous recherchons un responsable technologique expérimenté qui prendra en charge la plateforme cloud de TuneIn, notamment la sécurité de l’infrastructure, l’observabilité, l’excellence opérationnelle, la maintenance et l’optimisation des coûts. Ce poste implique également la gestion d’aspects clés de notre fonction informatique d’entreprise, notamment la gouvernance technologique, la gestion des incidents et la gestion des fournisseurs. Vous dirigerez des ingénieurs chargés à la fois des capacités transversales de la plateforme et des équipes d’ingénierie embarquées alignées sur les initiatives commerciales clés.

Vous dirigerez une équipe pluridisciplinaire composée de sept collaborateurs qui vous relèveront directement, issus des domaines de l’automatisation de l’infrastructure, des opérations techniques, de la sécurité et de l’informatique d’entreprise.

Ce poste est idéal pour une personne qui aime constituer des équipes hautement performantes, favoriser la maturité opérationnelle, améliorer la productivité de l’ingénierie et concilier stratégie à long terme et leadership technique sur le terrain.

Votre quotidien

Opérations d'ingénierie et fiabilité

  • Assurer l'excellence opérationnelle des systèmes de production de TuneIn, en garantissant une haute disponibilité, une évolutivité, une résilience, une sécurité et une rentabilité optimales.
  • Diriger les initiatives en matière de fiabilité, notamment l'observabilité, la surveillance, les alertes, la gestion des incidents, la reprise après sinistre, la planification des capacités et les objectifs de niveau de service (SLO).
  • Collaborer avec les équipes d'ingénierie afin d'améliorer la vitesse de déploiement, la préparation opérationnelle et la fiabilité de la production.
  • Améliorer en continu les plateformes CI/CD, les outils de développement et les fonctionnalités en libre-service qui permettent aux équipes d’ingénierie de développer et de déployer plus rapidement.
  • Gérer les incidents majeurs en production, mener des analyses des causes profondes et des analyses rétrospectives, tout en mettant en œuvre des mesures correctives à long terme.
  • Mettre en place et améliorer en continu les pratiques de permanence de l’équipe, en participant à la rotation si nécessaire.

Infrastructure et plateforme cloud

  • Diriger la stratégie, la feuille de route et l’évolution de l’infrastructure cloud, des services de plateforme et de l’automatisation de l’infrastructure de TuneIn.
  • Définir la stratégie d’infrastructure AWS, la gouvernance, la gestion des identités et des accès (IAM), la mise en réseau, la plateforme Kubernetes, l’architecture cloud et la gestion du cycle de vie de l’infrastructure.
  • Promouvoir l’Infrastructure comme Code et les pratiques axées sur l’automatisation dans les environnements AWS et Kubernetes.
  • Superviser la mise en réseau en production, le DNS, l’identité cloud, les outils de sécurité cloud et les services de plateforme.
  • Piloter l’optimisation des coûts cloud, la planification des capacités, les prévisions et le compte rendu opérationnel.
  • Superviser l’automatisation de l’infrastructure à l’aide de technologies telles que Terraform, ArgoCD, GitHub Actions, Kubernetes et des outils cloud natifs modernes.
  • Veiller à ce que l’architecture de la plateforme évolue pour soutenir la croissance future de l’entreprise tout en maintenant la fiabilité, l’évolutivité et l’efficacité opérationnelle.

Sécurité

  • Affiner, mettre en œuvre et surveiller les politiques de sécurité relatives à la sécurité du périmètre réseau, aux contrôles d’accès et à l’inventaire de l’infrastructure.
  • Organiser régulièrement des audits de sécurité, des tests d’intrusion, des initiatives de sensibilisation à la sécurité et des programmes de prime aux bogues.
  • Collaborer avec l’équipe d’ingénierie des données pour mettre en œuvre et superviser les politiques d’inventaire, de minimisation et de conservation des données.
  • Gérer et améliorer en permanence le plan d’intervention en cas d’incident de TuneIn, en jouant le rôle de coordinateur de la réponse aux incidents lors d’événements de sécurité.
  • Accompagner les révisions des politiques de sécurité de l’information avec les partenaires, les clients et les organismes de certification.

Informatique d’entreprise

  • Diriger la fonction informatique de TuneIn, notamment la gestion des terminaux, la gestion des identités et des accès, l'administration des solutions SaaS, les opérations du service d'assistance, la gestion du cycle de vie des actifs, ainsi que l'intégration et le départ des collaborateurs.
  • Superviser les technologies de collaboration interne, les systèmes de visioconférence, les équipements bureautiques et les plateformes de productivité d’entreprise.
  • Gérer les relations avec les fournisseurs, les licences logicielles, les renouvellements, les achats et la planification du budget informatique.
  • Évaluer et mettre en œuvre les technologies émergentes, notamment les outils de productivité basés sur l’IA, qui améliorent l’expérience des collaborateurs et l’efficacité opérationnelle.
  • Conduire une amélioration continue de l’expérience technologique des collaborateurs à l’échelle de l’organisation.

Leadership

  • Mettre en place, encadrer et développer une structure d'opérations techniques hautement performante.
  • Définir des priorités, des indicateurs et des processus opérationnels clairs pour l’ensemble de l’équipe.
  • Favoriser des partenariats interfonctionnels solides avec les équipes d’ingénierie, de sécurité, de produit, de finance et des ressources humaines.
  • Influencer l’orientation technique de l’ensemble de l’organisation par le biais de revues d’architecture, de bonnes pratiques opérationnelles et d’un leadership technique.
  • Élaborer des feuilles de route opérationnelles alignées sur les objectifs de l’entreprise et les priorités d’ingénierie.
  • Communiquer à la direction de l’ingénierie l’état de l’infrastructure, les indicateurs opérationnels, le niveau de sécurité et les initiatives stratégiques.

Ce que nous recherchons

Il s’agit d’un poste de leadership technologique à la fois stratégique et très opérationnel, couvrant les infrastructures de production, le SRE, les plateformes infonuagiques, les opérations de sécurité et l’IT d’entreprise. Nous recherchons un leader qui possède à la fois une expérience de gestion d’organisations techniques et une solide expertise technique lui permettant d’orienter les choix d’architecture, les décisions opérationnelles et la gestion des incidents majeurs.

Exigence linguistique

Une maîtrise professionnelle de l’anglais est requise pour ce poste, puisque celui-ci implique de diriger des équipes technologiques et de collaborer avec des équipes et des parties prenantes au Canada et à l’international. Le poste nécessite des communications régulières en anglais avec des parties prenantes techniques et non techniques, ainsi que la capacité de mener des discussions techniques complexes, de consulter de la documentation technique et de communiquer avec des partenaires internes et externes en anglais.

Expérience requise

  • Plus de 10 ans d’expérience dans l’ingénierie d’infrastructure, l’exploitation du cloud, l’ingénierie de plateformes, la fiabilité des sites ou les opérations techniques.
  • Plus de 5 ans d’expérience en gestion technique à la tête d’équipes techniques.
  • Expérience dans l’exploitation d’environnements de production à grande échelle sur AWS.
  • Expertise approfondie de Kubernetes, des infrastructures conteneurisées, de l’Infrastructure comme Code (Terraform et/ou Pulumi) et des plateformes CI/CD modernes.
  • Solide compréhension des plateformes d’observabilité, notamment Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana ou des technologies similaires.
  • Expérience dans la gestion des interventions en cas d’incident, des programmes d’excellence opérationnelle, de la planification de la reprise après sinistre et des initiatives visant à garantir la fiabilité de la production.
  • Solides connaissances en matière de réseaux, d’IAM, de sécurité cloud et d’architecture des systèmes distribués.
  • Expérience dans la gestion d’environnements informatiques d’entreprise, notamment la gestion des identités, la gestion des terminaux, les écosystèmes SaaS et les technologies destinées aux collaborateurs.
  • Capacité avérée à piloter l’automatisation, à améliorer la productivité de l’ingénierie et à réduire la complexité opérationnelle.
  • Expérience dans la recherche d’un équilibre entre fiabilité, performances, sécurité et optimisation des coûts du cloud.
  • Excellentes compétences en communication et capacité à travailler efficacement avec des parties prenantes techniques et non techniques.
  • Expérience technique de terrain et crédibilité nécessaires pour orienter les décisions architecturales tout en donnant aux ingénieurs les moyens de les mettre en œuvre.

Atouts

  • Expérience dans l'accompagnement de plateformes Internet grand public ou de streaming à grande échelle.
  • Expérience avec GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, Cloudflare, Route53, Snowflake ou des technologies similaires.
  • Connaissance des réseaux « Zero Trust », de la gestion moderne des terminaux et des meilleures pratiques en matière de sécurité d'entreprise.
  • Expérience dans la gestion d'équipes d'ingénieurs réparties à l'échelle mondiale.
  • Expérience dans le soutien d'initiatives liées à la conformité, à la confidentialité et à la sécurité, en collaboration avec les équipes de sécurité.

Nos avantages sociaux et notre rémunération

  • Couverture par des formules d'assurance santé haut de gamme pour les salariés et les personnes à charge éligibles, y compris des formules dentaires et ophtalmologiques.
  • Congé parental rémunéré.
  • Politique flexible en matière de congés payés
  • Allocation bien-être.
  • Allocation technologique.
  • Prise en charge des frais de formation et d'éducation individuels.
  • Allocation unique pour le télétravail.

Politique de confidentialité applicable au personnel

Pour consulter notre Avis de confidentialité applicable au personnel, qui explique comment nous traitons les données des candidats, cliquez ici.

raw.title: Manager, Recycling Materials Marketing and Recovery - Remote
raw.excerpt: OVERVIEWReporting to the Sr.  Manager of Post-Collection Operations, the Recycling Materials Marketing and Recovery Manager will lead the management of commodity marketing contracts and direct recycling agreements with secondary processors.
raw.description:
OVERVIEW

Reporting to the Sr. Manager of Post-Collection Operations, the Recycling Materials Marketing and Recovery Manager will lead the management of commodity marketing contracts and direct recycling agreements with secondary processors. This role is responsible for ensuring the efficient movement of materials through the system, optimizing revenue, and maintaining compliance with regulatory requirements. The MMRM will oversee material flow, performance tracking, and day-to-day issue resolution across marketing and processing partners, while working closely with internal teams to ensure accurate reporting, financial alignment, and achievement of regulatory recovery targets.

This is a full-time position, salaried paid and requires residency in Canada.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Manage commodity marketing agreements and direct contracts with secondary processors/end-markets, including performance, compliance, and commercial outcomes.
  • Track and manage material flow from preconditioning facilities to end-markets, ensuring continuity of movement and timely issue resolution.
  • Monitor material composition and quality, working with operations and audit teams to identify risks, discrepancies, and improvement opportunities.
  • Calculate and validate facility yields and recovery performance, ensuring alignment with contractual and regulatory expectations.
  • Ensure accurate and complete reporting from service providers, including reconciliation of volumes, revenues, and performance metrics.
  • Act as the primary liaison between post-collection operations, marketing agents, finance, audit, and service provider reporting teams to resolve daily operational and financial issues.
  • Work closely with post-collection operations managers to address processing, logistics, and material quality challenges impacting marketability and revenue.
  • Develop and maintain monthly and quarterly reports on:
    • Commodity market performance,
    • Marketing partner performance,
    • Revenue per ton and yield trends
    • Risks and opportunities.
  • Assess and support new market development opportunities, including domestic and export end-markets, to improve system resilience and maximize revenue.
  • Support contract implementation, change orders, and ongoing optimization of processing and marketing arrangements.
  • Proactively identify and resolve operational, contractual, and market-related issues impacting system performance.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education

  • Post-secondary education in business, supply chain, environmental management, or related fields is preferred.
  • An equivalent combination of education, and experiences may be considered.

Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in commodity marketing, recycling markets, or materials trading, with direct exposure to plastics, fiber, or metals markets.
  • Experience managing commercial contracts with processors, brokers, or end-markets.
  • Demonstrated experience tracking material flows, yields, and revenue performance within recycling or commodity supply chains.

Knowledge/Competencies/Skills

  • Preference will be given to candidates with a strong understanding of artificial intelligence (AI) concepts and the ability to communicate and apply AI technologies effectively within a business context.
  • Strong understanding of recycling commodity markets, pricing mechanisms, and end-market requirements.
  • Experience with data analysis, yield calculations, and performance reporting.
  • Ability to manage day-to-day operational issues across multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working with operations, finance, audit, and reporting teams.
  • High attention to detail with a focus on data accuracy and accountability.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills.
  • Self-starter with a high degree of motivation and ownership, able to operate independently and drive outcomes.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel and data analysis tools; experience with reporting systems and dashboards is an asset.

WORKING CONDITIONS

  • All CM employees work 40 hours per week, remotely from a Canadian home office environment.
  • Extra or flexible hours may be required on occasion. The job demands that the incumbent have a flexible work schedule with periods of uneven workload.
  • This role requires field work. As a result, there will be some variability in scheduling to accommodate operational needs.
  • A valid Driver’s license is required, and comprehensive vehicle insurance is required.

PAY TRANSPARENCY

ExpectedCompensation:

  • An annual base salary in the range of $90,000 to $110,000
  • The salary range listed complies with the Ontario Employment Standards Act and reflects a potential base salary range for this role. The actual salary offered will be determined within the range, and will depend on factors, such as the candidate’s unique qualifications, relevant experience, work location and expected contributions.

Job Vacancy Reason

  • This position is a net new role.

Artificial Intelligence

  • AI is not used during our hiring processes.

Applicant and Interviewee Communication

  • We thank all applicants for their interest. However, only those under consideration will be contacted.
  • Applicants who have been interviewed will be informed whether a hiring decision has been made within 45 days of their final interview.

Record Retention

  • Job posting records and associated application forms will be retained for at least three years.

ABOUT CIRCULAR MATERIALS

Circular Materials is a national not-for-profit producer responsibility organization (PRO) that supports producers in meeting their extended producer responsibility (EPR) obligations across Canada. Created by producers for producers, we design, , and deliver effective recycling programs that drive advance innovation, improve environmental outcomes and create value across the recycling supply chain.

Through full-service program delivery, including collection, management, promotion, education, and reporting, we are advancing systems where more materials are recycled and returned to producers for use in new packaging and products.

Learn more at circularmaterials.ca.

Circular Materials is an equal opportunity employer, committed to building a workforce that reflects diversity of thought, skills, experiences, and backgrounds as we work together to accelerate a circular economy for people and the planet.

Our inclusive hiring practices aim to foster a culture where all employees feel a strong sense of belonging. We are proud of our recent diversity survey results which showed that:

  • 54% of Circular Materials employees identify as women.
  • 50% of Circular Materials employees identify as visible minorities.
  • 90% of employees believe Circular Materials fosters a strong sense of belonging for employees of all backgrounds.
  • 86% of employees recommend Circular Materials as an inclusive workplace.

We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, including Indigenous Peoples (First Nations, Inuit, and Métis), persons with disabilities, racialized individuals, and members of the 2SLGBTQIA+ community. Circular Materials is committed to reconciliation and to advancing Indigenous representation and partnerships across our organization and programs. We recognize that we operate on the traditional territories of diverse Indigenous Nations, and are dedicated to respecting Indigenous rights, governance, and contributions in our work and communities.

Circular Materials supports reasonable requests for accommodation in accordance with all applicable provincial accessibility standards. Requests for accommodation will be provided by Circular Materials through the recruitment and/or assessment processes, upon . This email is only used for accommodation requests.

raw.description:
Our mission is to Profoundly change the standard of care by creating a tomorrow where clinicians can confidently ablate tissue with precision; a tomorrow where patients have access to safe and effective treatment options, so they can quickly return to their daily lives. Changing the standard of care is part of our fabric. We are a group of energetic, problem-solvers focused on innovation and looking to change the world. We are changing the paradigm for treating diseases such as prostate cancer by using real-time MR Imaging, thermal ultrasound and close-loop temperature feedback control, to gently ablate the diseased tissue with minimal side effects.

If you share our values and want to work in a collaborative results-focused culture and want to make a profound impact in healthcare and your career, here is your chance.

General Accountabilities

The Strategic Program Manager will support fully-cycle planning, execution, and optimization of TULSA-PRO® programs across clinical and operational workflows. This role will support program implementation, clinical adoption, and account management responsibilities to ensure successful deployment, utilization, and growth of TULSA-PRO® systems within partner hospitals and clinics. The Strategic Account Manager foster relationships with healthcare providers, and external stakeholders, delivering exceptional patient outcomes while driving business objectives.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Support the lifecycle of TULSA-PRO® implementation at clinical sites, including installation, workflow integration, and ongoing program optimization.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with physicians, hospital administrators, and clinical staff to drive utilization and adoption.
  • Act as point person for hospitals and clinical teams, ensuring alignment with program goals, timelines, and compliance standards.
  • Execute account-specific strategies to grow program awareness and procedural volume.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams (clinical, engineering, marketing, regulatory) to meet project milestones and deliverables.
  • Assist with physician and staff training programs to ensure proficiency and adoption of TULSA-PRO® technology.
  • Track and report on program performance, including clinical outcomes, utilization metrics, and financial performance.
  • Ensure adherence to regulatory requirements, design controls, and internal SOPs.
  • Represent TULSA-PRO® at marketing events, executive meetings, and presentations to demonstrate value propositions and support hospital system approval.
  • Identify opportunities for system upgrades, additional installations, and service expansions.

Education

Minimum Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required.

Key Attributes

About Us

At Prenuvo, we are on a mission to flip the paradigm from reactive “sick-care” to proactive health care. Our award-winning whole body scan is fast (under 1 hour), safe (MRI has no ionizing radiation), and non-invasive (no contrast). Our unique integrated stack of optimized hardware, software, and increasingly AI, coupled with the patient-centric experience across our domestic and global clinics, have allowed us to lead the change against “we caught it too late again".

We are looking for a Senior QA Engineer I to join our team! You will be responsible for ensuring the quality of a suite of tools for providers, patient workflows, and diagnostic reporting. Successful candidates will be ambitious, self-driven, and organized — deeply invested in both the user experience and the real-world functionality of our products.

This role is fully remote; however, we have a preference for candidates based in the Pacific Time Zone (PST) to better align with team collaboration.

This role does not provide visa sponsorship. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in Canada at the time of hire and must not require employer sponsorship for a work visa (current or future).

Help reshape the world through proactive healthcare while working with cutting-edge technology and high performing teams with deep expertise - join us to make a difference in people’s lives!

What You’ll Do

  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and developers to shape quality from the ground up.
  • Analyze and evaluate business requirements with product managers and translate them into test strategies.
  • Create, execute, and maintain test documentation and test plans.
  • Create and execute manual and automated testing of web applications: exploratory, functional, acceptance, regression, and UI testing.
  • Test APIs and backend services (REST, GraphQL) for robustness and correctness.
  • Ensure that quality issues and defects are appropriately identified, documented, prioritized, and tracked.
  • Lead root cause analysis with developers to accelerate defect resolution.
  • Mentor junior QA engineers and help instill best practices across the team.
  • Be an active voice in process improvements to raise product quality and engineering performance.
  • Integrate testing into CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous quality.
  • Ensure web applications meet accessibility standards (WCAG/ADA) through manual and automated testing.
  • Contribute to performance and security testing efforts where applicable..

What You’ll Bring

  • 4+ years of professional experience in software QA.
  • Strong knowledge of QA methodologies, tools, and processes.
  • Experience with test design techniques and practical implementation.
  • Strong knowledge of web technologies: HTML, CSS, client-server architecture, and APIs.
  • Experience testing RESTful and GraphQL APIs.
  • Awareness of accessibility standards (e.g., WCAG) and experience testing with tools like Axe, Lighthouse, or screen readers.
  • Experience with automated testing frameworks (Selenium, Cypress, Appium, Espresso, XCUITest).
  • Solid experience with bug tracking systems (e.g., JIRA).
  • Strong analytical and communication skills, with proven problem-solving abilities.
  • A collaborative mindset and a passion for delivering high-quality, user-centered products.
  • BS degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent professional experience.

Nice to Have

  • Experience testing native mobile applications (iOS and/or Android).
  • Familiarity with mobile app testing tools such as Xcode, Android Studio, Appium, Detox, or BrowserStack.
  • Understanding of mobile app distribution workflows (TestFlight, Google Play Console) and CI/CD integration.
  • Experience designing and executing accessibility test strategies to ensure inclusive user experiences.
  • Experience contributing to performance and security testing initiatives.
  • Experience testing healthcare applications, electronic health record (EHR) systems, or products handling sensitive health data (HIPAA, PHIPA, or similar compliance environments).

Our Values

First: we are Pioneers

  • Transforming healthcare requires divergent thinking, bias for action, disciplined experimentation, and consistent grit and determination to maintain momentum. This journey is as challenging as it is rewarding.

Second: we are Platform-Builders

  • We’re always building foundations that allow us to achieve tomorrow more than we did today. We never lose sight of what’s ahead – in a mindset of ownership and duty to our mission.

Above all: we are Patients

  • We could all be the next person who walks through our very doors, seeking clarity or peace of mind. We are proud of our impact on our patients’ lives, and we won’t stop till everyone can benefit from our work.

What We Offer

  • An avenue to make a positive impact on people's lives and their health
  • We believe in preventative healthcare for everyone, including our team - Prenuvo provides free, whole-body scans to each team member
  • Growth opportunities are at the heart of our people journey, we’re doing big things with bright minds - there is no single path to success, it can be shaped along the way
  • Building strong relationships is at the core of everything we do - our team gets together each week to connect, share, and socialize
  • Recognizing time away to restore is vital to our wellbeing - we have a flexible vacation policy and we will encourage you to use it
  • We offer a comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, vision, including Mental Health coverage, to support you and your family
  • Prenuvo offers eligible Canadian employees access to both RRSP and TFSA retirement savings plans, with immediate, optional enrollment and the flexibility to invest and save for the future on your own terms. While Prenuvo provides access to these plans, the company does not currently offer matching contributions
  • The base salary for this role ranges from $136,000-$148,000 in local currency, depending upon experience and geographic location

We are an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Mindrift is looking for skilled Bot Developers (WhatsApp Business API, Telegram Bot API, Discord API) to join the Tendem project () and build conversational bots and messaging-platform integrations for real-world applications. In this role, you'll use your bot engineering expertise, conversational design skills, and quality-focused approach to build reliable, useful bots and messaging integrations that deliver a great user experience. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for professionals with hands-on experience building messaging bots, working with platform APIs and webhooks, and implementing conversational logic.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Bot Developer, you'll design, build, and refine messaging bots for one or more messaging platforms, including WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Slack, and similar platforms — for use cases such as customer service, appointment booking, order taking, content delivery, moderation, and automated notifications.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build bots for one or more messaging platforms, such as WhatsApp (Business API / Cloud API), Telegram (Bot API), Discord, Slack and similar messaging platforms.
  • Design and implement conversational flows, dialogue state, and fallback handling.
  • Integrate bots with LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) for natural language responses where appropriate.
  • Connect bots to backend services, databases, CRMs, and third-party APIs (booking systems, payment, content sources).
  • Handle webhooks, rate limits, and platform-specific message formats (interactive messages, buttons, media, templates).
  • Review, debug, optimize, and refactor bot implementations to improve correctness, reliability, maintainability, and graceful error handling.
  • Implement logging, monitoring, and recovery so bots stay healthy in production.

Requirements and benefits

Educational qualifications

  • At least 3 years of relevant experience backend, integration, automation, or bot development experience (required).
  • Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related technical fields is a plus.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a strong foundation in bot development, messaging platform integrations, and building reliable conversational workflows. We are looking for specialists who can design and maintain production-ready bots, work confidently with APIs, webhooks, and backend services, and build stable, user-friendly bot experiences. Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently are essential.

Technical Skills (Essential)

  • At least 1 year of hands-on experience building bots for at least one major messaging platforms (WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Slack, or similar) is required
  • Strong command of Python or Node.js for backend bot logic.
  • Solid experience with REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, and async request handling.
  • Experience with relational or NoSQL databases for storing conversation state and user data.
  • Familiarity with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic) and prompt design for conversational use is a strong plus.
  • Understanding of platform-specific limits, message templates, and approval flows (e.g., WhatsApp template messages).
  • Experience with hosting and deployment (Docker, serverless, VPS, or PaaS)

Additional requirements

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to bot reliability — no silent failures, no broken flows.
  • Self-directed work ethic with the ability to design and ship complete bots independently.
  • Portfolio or examples of bots you've built (required).
  • English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $35 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Work fully remote on your own schedule with just a laptop and stable internet connection.
  • Apply your expertise to real-world technology projects while gaining experience building high-quality solutions for a global platform.
  • Participate in performance-based bonus programs that reward high-quality work and consistent delivery.

Most Important Things (MITs)

raw.description:
This is a remote position.

AIMPROSOFT — Architect/Senior BigCommerce Developer!

Aimprosoft, a fast-growing IT company, is looking for a Senior BigCommerce Developer to join a long- term international project in the B2B E-commerce domain.

We are looking for an experienced BigCommerce specialist who can take ownership of an existing production solution, help stabilize it, troubleshoot complex issues, and contribute to its further development and technical improvement.

About the project & role:

The project is a B2B e-commerce platform for a European client. The existing solution is built on BigCommerce and integrates with several enterprise systems, including ERP, PIM, middleware, external search, and custom integration components.

This is not a greenfield implementation. The project is moving through a: Takeover → Stabilization → Support → Further Development phase.

Initially, your focus will be on knowledge transfer, understanding the existing BigCommerce implementation and integrations, investigating current issues, and stabilizing the production solution.

Once the platform is stabilized, the focus will gradually shift toward new functionality, integration improvements, technical debt reduction, and optimization of the existing architecture.

What We Need From You:

  • English: Upper-Intermediate (B2) or higher
  • Strong hands-on commercial experience with BigCommerce in production environments.
  • Deep understanding of BigCommerce platform configuration and core commerce functionality.
  • Hands-on experience with BigCommerce REST APIs, Webhooks, and Stencil.
  • Experience developing and troubleshooting custom BigCommerce integrations.
  • Strong knowledge of REST APIs, XML/JSON, data synchronization, and integration patterns.
  • Experience integrating e-commerce platforms with ERP, PIM, middleware, or other enterprise systems.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and experience supporting complex production solutions.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.
  • Experience with Laravel / PHP.
  • Experience with Typesense, Patchworks, Prodexa, or similar platforms.
  • Experience with SAP Commerce / Hybris or enterprise B2B e-commerce.
  • Previous experience taking over and stabilizing an existing BigCommerce implementation.

What We Offer:

  • A competitive salary that appreciates your skills and experience
  • Cozy atmosphere and modern approaches. We have neither bureaucracy nor strict management nor “working under pressure” conditions
  • Opportunity to implement your ideas, tools, and approaches. We are open to changes and suggestions aimed at improvement
  • Work on a strategic, large-scale international project with high visibility.
  • Remote-friendly culture with strong team collaboration.

Proficient in:

Berkshire Grey is a leader in AI-powered robotics, delivering intelligent automation solutions for e-commerce, retail, and logistics. Our systems transform pick, pack, and sort operations through advanced robotics and software.

You will define and build the simulations that support system-level decision making, accelerate product development, and ensure robust performance in real-world environments.

  • Collaborate closely withrobotics, perception, controls, and applications teamsto ensure alignment between simulation and real-world system behavior.
  • Develop tools and infrastructure fortesting, debugging, and validating robotic systems in simulation.
  • Providetechnical leadership and mentorship, establishing best practices in simulation and software engineering.
  • Influenceengineering strategy and roadmapfor modeling, simulation, and system architecture.

raw.description:
Location: Remote — Global Compensation: Open / Competitive based on experience

About Logicstics

Logicstics is a rapidly growing international moving company and freight forwarder specializing in household goods relocations worldwide. We pride ourselves on exceptional customer service, innovative technology, and making international relocations as seamless as possible.

We are seeking an experienced General Manager to lead and grow our International Moving Division.

This is a senior leadership position for someone who already has significant, hands-on experience in the international moving industry. We are not looking for a general logistics manager who needs to learn international moving.

The successful candidate should already have a firm understanding of how an international moving company operates and be capable of taking significant day-to-day responsibility off ownership.

About the Role

The General Manager will oversee the day-to-day performance of the International Moving Division and take ownership across:

  • Sales
  • Operations
  • Pricing
  • Sales Support
  • Customer Service

You will lead teams, establish accountability, improve processes, develop employees, manage escalations, and ensure the division operates efficiently while continuing to grow.

This is a hands-on leadership position requiring someone who can move comfortably between strategy, people management, operational problem-solving, and execution.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the day-to-day operations of the International Moving Division.
  • Oversee Sales, Operations, Pricing, Sales Support, and Customer Service functions.
  • Recruit, train, coach, and manage remote employees and department leaders.
  • Establish KPIs and performance standards across departments.
  • Hold teams accountable for results and operational execution.
  • Improve sales processes, close rates, workflows, and customer experience.
  • Review pricing strategies and ensure quotes are accurate, competitive, and commercially sound.
  • Coach sales representatives and improve overall sales performance.
  • Identify operational bottlenecks and implement scalable solutions.
  • Handle complex and escalated customer situations professionally.
  • Develop, document, and improve SOPs across the division.
  • Ensure proper coordination between sales, pricing, operations, and customer service.
  • Maintain compliance with international shipping regulations and industry best practices.
  • Work directly with ownership on growth initiatives, technology implementation, hiring, and strategic planning.
  • Take meaningful operational responsibility away from ownership so leadership can focus on broader growth opportunities.

Requirements

Required Industry Experience

Direct international moving experience is non-negotiable.

Candidates must have significant professional experience working specifically within an international moving company or international household goods division.

General freight, transportation, supply chain, or logistics experience without international moving experience will not be sufficient.

Candidates should have extensive knowledge of:

  • International household goods moving
  • International moving operations
  • Ocean freight
  • Air freight
  • Customs procedures
  • International shipping documentation
  • Origin and destination services
  • International moving pricing and quoting
  • Shipment coordination
  • Customer escalations
  • International moving industry standards and processes

Required Leadership Experience

  • Ideally 10+ years of international household goods moving experience.
  • Significant experience managing operations for an international moving company or major international moving division.
  • Proven experience leading teams and developing employees.
  • Experience overseeing multiple functions such as Operations, Sales, Pricing, Sales Support, and Customer Service.
  • Ability to establish KPIs and manage teams against measurable performance expectations.
  • Strong coaching and performance-management capabilities.
  • Experience resolving complex customer and operational escalations.
  • Strong commercial understanding of pricing, profitability, sales performance, and operational efficiency.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving abilities.
  • High level of computer proficiency.

Experience with CRM, transportation-management, and workflow software is highly preferred.

Experience working with the U.S. international moving market is a strong advantage.

What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate is:

  • An international moving industry veteran who can contribute immediately.
  • A hands-on operator, not someone who only manages from a distance.
  • Comfortable making decisions independently.
  • Commercially minded and understands the relationship between pricing, sales, operations, and profitability.
  • Process-driven and capable of bringing structure to a growing organization.
  • Strong at coaching employees and improving team performance.
  • Comfortable handling difficult customer and operational situations.
  • Accountable and results-oriented.
  • Able to identify problems before they become larger issues.
  • Comfortable working directly with ownership in an entrepreneurial environment.

Benefits

Compensation

Open and based on experience.

Logicstics recognizes that this is a highly specialized and valuable leadership position and is prepared to pay competitively for the right candidate.

Compensation will be evaluated based on the candidate's international moving experience, leadership scope, operational expertise, and ability to take ownership of the division.

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary
  • Paid vacation and holidays
  • Paid training and onboarding
  • Long-term career growth
  • Significant ownership and influence over the International Moving Division
  • Opportunity to shape processes, teams, technology, and future growth
  • Direct collaboration with company ownership

Important: Due to the specialized nature of this position, only candidates with substantial direct international moving experience will be considered.

raw.description:
About TuneIn

TuneIn, the world’s leading live audio service, brings together live radio, sports, news, music, podcasts, and audiobooks from around the globe. With more than 75 million monthly active users, TuneIn is one of the world's most widely used audio platforms. TuneIn broadcasts over 100,000 owned & operated and partner radio stations. With premier distribution across 200 platforms and connected devices including Tesla and Alexa, TuneIn empowers listeners to hear what they love wherever they are, including exclusive commercial-free stations from the minds of folks like Garth Brooks. TuneIn Premium subscribers get additional exclusive access to commercial-free news from top networks like CNN, Fox News Radio, MSNBC, and Bloomberg, as well as live, can't-miss F1, MLB, NHL, and college sports. For more information, please visit us at Tunein.com or follow us on Instagram, or X.

Our engineering teams build and operate highly available, globally distributed systems that power one of the world's largest live audio platforms. We're looking for a technical leader who is excited about operating reliable infrastructure at scale while enabling engineers to move faster through automation, modern tooling, and operational excellence.

About the Position

TuneIn is looking for a Director of Tech Ops & IT to lead the teams and technologies responsible for our production infrastructure, cloud operations, site reliability, infrastructure automation, corporate IT, and internal technology services.

We are looking for an experienced technology leader to own TuneIn's cloud platform, including infrastructure security, observability, operational excellence, maintenance, and cost optimization. This role also leads key aspects of our corporate IT function, including technology governance, incident response, and vendor management. You'll manage engineers supporting both cross-functional platform capabilities and embedded engineering teams aligned to key business initiatives.

You'll lead a multidisciplinary team of seven direct reports across Infrastructure Automation, Tech Operations, Security, and Corporate IT.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building high-performing teams, driving operational maturity, improving engineering productivity, and balancing long-term strategy with hands-on technical leadership.

What You'll Do
Engineering Operations & Reliability

  • Drive operational excellence across TuneIn's production systems, ensuring high availability, scalability, resiliency, security, and cost efficiency.
  • Lead reliability initiatives, including observability, monitoring, alerting, incident management, disaster recovery, capacity planning, and service level objectives (SLOs).
  • Partner with Engineering teams to improve deployment velocity, operational readiness, and production reliability.
  • Continuously improve CI/CD platforms, developer tooling, and self-service capabilities that enable engineering teams to build and ship faster.
  • Lead major production incidents, root cause analyses, and postmortems while driving long-term corrective actions.
  • Establish and continuously improve the team's on-call practices, participating in the rotation as needed.

Cloud Infrastructure & Platform

  • Own the strategy, roadmap, and evolution of TuneIn's cloud infrastructure, platform services, and infrastructure automation.
  • Define AWS infrastructure strategy, governance, IAM, networking, Kubernetes platform, cloud architecture, and infrastructure lifecycle management.
  • Champion Infrastructure as Code and automation-first practices across AWS and Kubernetes environments.
  • Oversee production networking, DNS, cloud identity, cloud security tooling, and platform services.
  • Drive cloud cost optimization, capacity planning, forecasting, and operational reporting.
  • Oversee infrastructure automation using technologies such as Terraform, ArgoCD, GitHub Actions, Kubernetes, and modern cloud-native tooling.
  • Ensure platform architecture evolves to support future business growth while maintaining reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency.

Security

  • Refine, implement, and monitor security policies related to network perimeter security, access controls, and infrastructure inventory.
  • Facilitate regular security reviews, penetration testing, security awareness initiatives, and bug bounty programs.
  • Partner with Data Engineering to implement and oversee data inventory, minimization, and retention policies.
  • Own and continuously improve TuneIn's incident response plan, serving as the incident response coordinator during security events.
  • Support information security policy reviews with partners, customers, and certification bodies.

Corporate IT

  • Lead TuneIn's corporate IT function, including endpoint management, identity and access management, SaaS administration, helpdesk operations, asset lifecycle management, and employee onboarding/offboarding.
  • Oversee internal collaboration technologies, conferencing systems, office technology, and enterprise productivity platforms.
  • Manage vendor relationships, software licensing, renewals, procurement, and IT budget planning.
  • Evaluate and implement emerging technologies, including AI-enabled productivity tools, that improve employee experience and operational effectiveness.
  • Drive continuous improvements to the employee technology experience across the organization.

Leadership

  • Build, mentor, and develop a high-performing Technical Operations organization.
  • Establish clear priorities, metrics, and operational processes across the team.
  • Foster strong cross-functional partnerships with Engineering, Security, Product, Finance, and People teams.
  • Influence technical direction across the organization through architecture reviews, operational best practices, and technical leadership.
  • Develop operational roadmaps aligned with company objectives and engineering priorities.
  • Communicate infrastructure health, operational metrics, security posture, and strategic initiatives to engineering leadership.

What We're Looking For

This is a hands-on technology leadership role spanning production infrastructure, SRE, cloud platform, security operations, and corporate IT. We're looking for a leader who has both managed technical organizations and maintained enough technical depth to guide architecture, operational decisions, and major incidents.

Language Requirement

Professional fluency in English is required for this role because the position leads and collaborates with technology teams and stakeholders across Canada and internationally. The role requires regular communication in English with technical and non-technical stakeholders, as well as the ability to conduct complex technical discussions, review technical documentation, and communicate with internal and external partners in English.

Required Experience

  • 10+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering, cloud operations, platform engineering, site reliability, or technical operations.
  • 5+ years of engineering management experience leading technical teams.
  • Experience operating large-scale production environments on AWS.
  • Deep expertise with Kubernetes, containerized infrastructure, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform and/or Pulumi), and modern CI/CD platforms.
  • Strong understanding of observability platforms including Datadog, Prometheus, Graphana or similar technologies.
  • Experience leading incident response, operational excellence programs, disaster recovery planning, and production reliability initiatives.
  • Strong knowledge of networking, IAM, cloud security, and distributed systems architecture.
  • Experience managing enterprise IT environments including identity management, endpoint management, SaaS ecosystems, and employee technology.
  • Proven ability to drive automation, improve engineering productivity, and reduce operational complexity.
  • Experience balancing reliability, performance, security, and cloud cost optimization.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Hands-on technical background with the credibility to guide architectural decisions while empowering engineers to execute.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting high-scale consumer internet or streaming platforms.
  • Experience with GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, Cloudflare, Route53, Snowflake, or similar technologies.
  • Familiarity with Zero Trust networking, modern endpoint management, and enterprise security best practices.
  • Experience managing globally distributed engineering teams.
  • Experience supporting compliance, privacy, and security initiatives in partnership with Security teams.

Our Benefits & Compensation

  • Coverage of premium health plans for employees and eligible dependents, including dental and vision plans.
  • Paid parental leave.
  • Flexible PTO policy
  • Wellness stipend.
  • Technology stipend.
  • Individual training and educational spending.
  • WFH one-time stipend.

Workforce Privacy Policy

To view our Workforce Privacy Notice, which covers how we treat candidate data, click here.

Directeur des opérations techniques et de l'informatique

Lieu : Canada / À distance

À propos de TuneIn

Chez TuneIn, nous réinventons l’écoute pour un monde connecté. Nous réunissons des événements sportifs en direct, les dernières actualités, de la musique, des podcasts et plus de 100 000 stations de radio, afin de diffuser du contenu à des millions d’auditeurs via les mobiles, le Web, les véhicules connectés, les enceintes intelligentes, les téléviseurs, les appareils portables et des centaines d’appareils intégrés à travers le monde.

Nos équipes d’ingénieurs développent et exploitent des systèmes hautement disponibles et répartis à l’échelle mondiale, qui alimentent l’une des plus grandes plateformes audio en direct au monde. Nous recherchons un responsable technique passionné par l’exploitation d’une infrastructure fiable à grande échelle, capable de permettre aux ingénieurs d’accélérer leur rythme de travail grâce à l’automatisation, à des outils modernes et à l’excellence opérationnelle.

À propos du poste

TuneIn recherche un directeur des opérations techniques et de l'informatique pour diriger les équipes et les technologies en charge de notre infrastructure de production, des opérations cloud, de la fiabilité du site, de l'automatisation de l'infrastructure, de l'informatique d'entreprise et des services technologiques internes.

Nous recherchons un responsable technologique expérimenté qui prendra en charge la plateforme cloud de TuneIn, notamment la sécurité de l’infrastructure, l’observabilité, l’excellence opérationnelle, la maintenance et l’optimisation des coûts. Ce poste implique également la gestion d’aspects clés de notre fonction informatique d’entreprise, notamment la gouvernance technologique, la gestion des incidents et la gestion des fournisseurs. Vous dirigerez des ingénieurs chargés à la fois des capacités transversales de la plateforme et des équipes d’ingénierie embarquées alignées sur les initiatives commerciales clés.

Vous dirigerez une équipe pluridisciplinaire composée de sept collaborateurs qui vous relèveront directement, issus des domaines de l’automatisation de l’infrastructure, des opérations techniques, de la sécurité et de l’informatique d’entreprise.

Ce poste est idéal pour une personne qui aime constituer des équipes hautement performantes, favoriser la maturité opérationnelle, améliorer la productivité de l’ingénierie et concilier stratégie à long terme et leadership technique sur le terrain.

Votre quotidien

Opérations d'ingénierie et fiabilité

  • Assurer l'excellence opérationnelle des systèmes de production de TuneIn, en garantissant une haute disponibilité, une évolutivité, une résilience, une sécurité et une rentabilité optimales.
  • Diriger les initiatives en matière de fiabilité, notamment l'observabilité, la surveillance, les alertes, la gestion des incidents, la reprise après sinistre, la planification des capacités et les objectifs de niveau de service (SLO).
  • Collaborer avec les équipes d'ingénierie afin d'améliorer la vitesse de déploiement, la préparation opérationnelle et la fiabilité de la production.
  • Améliorer en continu les plateformes CI/CD, les outils de développement et les fonctionnalités en libre-service qui permettent aux équipes d’ingénierie de développer et de déployer plus rapidement.
  • Gérer les incidents majeurs en production, mener des analyses des causes profondes et des analyses rétrospectives, tout en mettant en œuvre des mesures correctives à long terme.
  • Mettre en place et améliorer en continu les pratiques de permanence de l’équipe, en participant à la rotation si nécessaire.

Infrastructure et plateforme cloud

  • Diriger la stratégie, la feuille de route et l’évolution de l’infrastructure cloud, des services de plateforme et de l’automatisation de l’infrastructure de TuneIn.
  • Définir la stratégie d’infrastructure AWS, la gouvernance, la gestion des identités et des accès (IAM), la mise en réseau, la plateforme Kubernetes, l’architecture cloud et la gestion du cycle de vie de l’infrastructure.
  • Promouvoir l’Infrastructure comme Code et les pratiques axées sur l’automatisation dans les environnements AWS et Kubernetes.
  • Superviser la mise en réseau en production, le DNS, l’identité cloud, les outils de sécurité cloud et les services de plateforme.
  • Piloter l’optimisation des coûts cloud, la planification des capacités, les prévisions et le compte rendu opérationnel.
  • Superviser l’automatisation de l’infrastructure à l’aide de technologies telles que Terraform, ArgoCD, GitHub Actions, Kubernetes et des outils cloud natifs modernes.
  • Veiller à ce que l’architecture de la plateforme évolue pour soutenir la croissance future de l’entreprise tout en maintenant la fiabilité, l’évolutivité et l’efficacité opérationnelle.

Sécurité

  • Affiner, mettre en œuvre et surveiller les politiques de sécurité relatives à la sécurité du périmètre réseau, aux contrôles d’accès et à l’inventaire de l’infrastructure.
  • Organiser régulièrement des audits de sécurité, des tests d’intrusion, des initiatives de sensibilisation à la sécurité et des programmes de prime aux bogues.
  • Collaborer avec l’équipe d’ingénierie des données pour mettre en œuvre et superviser les politiques d’inventaire, de minimisation et de conservation des données.
  • Gérer et améliorer en permanence le plan d’intervention en cas d’incident de TuneIn, en jouant le rôle de coordinateur de la réponse aux incidents lors d’événements de sécurité.
  • Accompagner les révisions des politiques de sécurité de l’information avec les partenaires, les clients et les organismes de certification.

Informatique d’entreprise

  • Diriger la fonction informatique de TuneIn, notamment la gestion des terminaux, la gestion des identités et des accès, l'administration des solutions SaaS, les opérations du service d'assistance, la gestion du cycle de vie des actifs, ainsi que l'intégration et le départ des collaborateurs.
  • Superviser les technologies de collaboration interne, les systèmes de visioconférence, les équipements bureautiques et les plateformes de productivité d’entreprise.
  • Gérer les relations avec les fournisseurs, les licences logicielles, les renouvellements, les achats et la planification du budget informatique.
  • Évaluer et mettre en œuvre les technologies émergentes, notamment les outils de productivité basés sur l’IA, qui améliorent l’expérience des collaborateurs et l’efficacité opérationnelle.
  • Conduire une amélioration continue de l’expérience technologique des collaborateurs à l’échelle de l’organisation.

Leadership

  • Mettre en place, encadrer et développer une structure d'opérations techniques hautement performante.
  • Définir des priorités, des indicateurs et des processus opérationnels clairs pour l’ensemble de l’équipe.
  • Favoriser des partenariats interfonctionnels solides avec les équipes d’ingénierie, de sécurité, de produit, de finance et des ressources humaines.
  • Influencer l’orientation technique de l’ensemble de l’organisation par le biais de revues d’architecture, de bonnes pratiques opérationnelles et d’un leadership technique.
  • Élaborer des feuilles de route opérationnelles alignées sur les objectifs de l’entreprise et les priorités d’ingénierie.
  • Communiquer à la direction de l’ingénierie l’état de l’infrastructure, les indicateurs opérationnels, le niveau de sécurité et les initiatives stratégiques.

Ce que nous recherchons

Il s’agit d’un poste de leadership technologique à la fois stratégique et très opérationnel, couvrant les infrastructures de production, le SRE, les plateformes infonuagiques, les opérations de sécurité et l’IT d’entreprise. Nous recherchons un leader qui possède à la fois une expérience de gestion d’organisations techniques et une solide expertise technique lui permettant d’orienter les choix d’architecture, les décisions opérationnelles et la gestion des incidents majeurs.

Exigence linguistique

Une maîtrise professionnelle de l’anglais est requise pour ce poste, puisque celui-ci implique de diriger des équipes technologiques et de collaborer avec des équipes et des parties prenantes au Canada et à l’international. Le poste nécessite des communications régulières en anglais avec des parties prenantes techniques et non techniques, ainsi que la capacité de mener des discussions techniques complexes, de consulter de la documentation technique et de communiquer avec des partenaires internes et externes en anglais.

Expérience requise

  • Plus de 10 ans d’expérience dans l’ingénierie d’infrastructure, l’exploitation du cloud, l’ingénierie de plateformes, la fiabilité des sites ou les opérations techniques.
  • Plus de 5 ans d’expérience en gestion technique à la tête d’équipes techniques.
  • Expérience dans l’exploitation d’environnements de production à grande échelle sur AWS.
  • Expertise approfondie de Kubernetes, des infrastructures conteneurisées, de l’Infrastructure comme Code (Terraform et/ou Pulumi) et des plateformes CI/CD modernes.
  • Solide compréhension des plateformes d’observabilité, notamment Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana ou des technologies similaires.
  • Expérience dans la gestion des interventions en cas d’incident, des programmes d’excellence opérationnelle, de la planification de la reprise après sinistre et des initiatives visant à garantir la fiabilité de la production.
  • Solides connaissances en matière de réseaux, d’IAM, de sécurité cloud et d’architecture des systèmes distribués.
  • Expérience dans la gestion d’environnements informatiques d’entreprise, notamment la gestion des identités, la gestion des terminaux, les écosystèmes SaaS et les technologies destinées aux collaborateurs.
  • Capacité avérée à piloter l’automatisation, à améliorer la productivité de l’ingénierie et à réduire la complexité opérationnelle.
  • Expérience dans la recherche d’un équilibre entre fiabilité, performances, sécurité et optimisation des coûts du cloud.
  • Excellentes compétences en communication et capacité à travailler efficacement avec des parties prenantes techniques et non techniques.
  • Expérience technique de terrain et crédibilité nécessaires pour orienter les décisions architecturales tout en donnant aux ingénieurs les moyens de les mettre en œuvre.

Atouts
